Clare: All-hands in 12. Quick: deck swap at T-3 (we replaced Q2 with the late patch). Harper, can you confirm teleprompter sync?

Marcus: Teleprompter had a hiccup during rehearsal. I'll re-sync at T-4 and keep an eye. If it lags, presenters should use speaker notes.

Jin: Also flagging a possible audio loop in greenroom when presenter joins Zoom with both headset + room mic. Recommend presenters plug into single device or mute Zoom mic until on stage.

Harper: Re: captions, we'll use LiveCaption bridge (ws://livecaption.internal/session) as primary; Zoom native as secondary. I'll enable at T-2.

OpsBot: Streaming plan: Zoom (share) -> OBS -> CDN. Fallback: OBS direct ingest or local screen capture to /recordings/allhands/2012345678_backup.mp4. Posting failover to #all-hands-ops.

Marcus: If teleprompter fails, cue card flow: 1) moderator reads headline, 2) leader gives 30s update, 3) open Q&A. Keep answers short.

Clare: Logistics: leadership Q&A at T+14. Pin follow-ups to the Q&A doc and tag owners. If recording stops, we'll keep live stream for 9 minutes while we reattach backups.

Jin: Ops note for OBS team: toggle LiveCaption overlay with obs-websocket command if captions glitch:

curl -X POST http://localhost:4444 -d '{"request-type":"SetSourceSettings","sourceName":"LiveCaptionBrowser","sourceSettings":{"url":"ws://livecaption.internal/session"}}'

Harper: Pinned Q&A doc: https://docs.internal/all-hands/2026-07-qa  Add one-line follow-ups and owner tags.

OpsBot: Recording started -> /recordings/allhands/2012345678_primary.mp4 :record_button:

Clare: Thanks. Marcus will cue at T+13 for handoff. Everyone please double-check slides are the final upload. :eyes:
